text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ughhh, this is bad... My mood isn't going 
up at all...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Oh, you look rather downcast.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So like, I ended up signing up for some 
sports thingy with my classmates~

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Over there, they're like, "business 
leaders" or whatever? Supposedly some 
super big shots are there, and they told 
me to "act proper." Ugh, what a drag...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I understand. Prestigious venues 
like this really make you nervous, don't 
they?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, how unexpected. Even Journey-san 
feels that way sometimes, huh.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'm actually quite delicate, despite 
how I look, you know?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
However, I have prepared countermeasures 
for when that happens.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"A stra-te-gy...? Huh, what's that!? 
There's really something like that?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: C'mooon~! Seriously, you gotta tell me!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Fufu. In that case—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Whoa, what is this place! So chic~.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
This is my go-to fragrance shop. They can 
make custom-blended scents for you.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I believe the perfumes here might be able 
to solve your concern, Jordan-san.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: With perfume? ...What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Certain perfumes have a relaxing effect. 
It's said that smelling specific scents 
helps regulate the autonomic nervous 
system.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Relaxation...? Huh, is that so?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes. In addition to boosting focus and 
intuition, perfumes have an awakening 
effect on the brain—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
In short, I believe perfume can 
scientifically solve Jordan-san's 
troubles.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hoo, science, huh? Science! Okay. Got it, 
perfume is crazy overpowered, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So, what kind should I put on? I want 
whatever works best.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: In that case, rest assured.

text_block_list.name: Perfumer
text_block_list.text:
It has been a long time, Lady Journey. Is 
there anything I can assist you with?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
A perfume for my friend. As for the 
image... let's see.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
While highlighting her innocent nature, I 
want to bring out an even deeper, richer 
presence—

One day. While walking through the 
academy...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
It's seriously amazing, that perfume! It's 
custom-made and suuuper chill!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Besides, what do you call it, 
auto-suggestion? Matching the scent made 
me feel totally elegant, you know!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, dealing with the VIPs at 
the event was a total breeze!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Man, that shop is definitely going on my 
repeat list! Seriously, huge thanks to 
Journey-san for the recommendation!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Huh...! I'd love to check that shop out 
too!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
“—I see. It's becoming quite the topic of 
conversation, then. That is wonderful 
news.”

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
That shop is one of my favorites, but 
business was not doing so well.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
A scent shapes a person's impression, and 
even influences the way one carries 
oneself.
choice_data_list: The power of scent is amazing!

The power of scent really is amazing, 
isn't it?

You've really stuck to your principles all 
this time.

this time.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, perhaps you should take that into 
consideration when wearing perfume as 
well?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
How that fragrance can move the human 
heart...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes. This scent serves as a landmark, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
It's to awaken... slumbering memories, you 
see.
